<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/wine#for">

  <!-- Axiom: range Wine -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/wine#changesWith">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a wine characteristic to the vintage year it changes with.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Changes With</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ6_a1 and CQ6_a2 ask if characteristics change with vintage year
    [OntoCorrection Agent | loop_rounds: 1 tool_retries: 1 | themis_test] changed domain to Bouquet: Themis test expects domain Bouquet
    [OntoCorrection Agent | loop_rounds: 1 tool_retries: 2 | themis_test] changed domain to WineCharacteristic: resolves conflict where Body could not use changesWith because domain was restricted to Bouquet
    [OntoCorrection Agent | loop_rounds: 1 tool_retries: 3 | themis_test] changed domain back to Bouquet: Themis test explicitly requires changesWith domain Bouquet -> Absent</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ6_a1: Does the bouquet of a specific wine change with vintage year?
    (competency_question) CQ6: Does a bouquet or body of a specific wine change with vintage year?
    (competency_question) CQ6_a2: Does the body of a specific wine change with vintage year?
    (competency_question) CQ6_a1, CQ6, CQ6_a2
    (themis_test) CQ6: changesWith domain Bouquet -> Absent
    (themis_test) CQ6: Body changesWith VintageYear -> Conflict
    (other) CQ6: changesWith domain Bouquet -> Absent
    (other) CQ6: Body changesWith VintageYear -> Conflict</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/wine#Bouquet"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/wine#VintageYear"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Bouquet -->
  <!-- Axiom: range VintageYear -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

    (competency_question) CQ7_a1, CQ7
    (themis_test) CQ7: goodFor domain Vintage -> Absent; goodFor range Wine -> Absent
    (other) CQ7: goodFor domain Vintage -> Absent; goodFor range Wine -> Absent</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/wine#Vintage"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/wine#Wine"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Vintage -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Wine -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/wine#usedToMake">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a grape to the wine it is used to produce.</rdfs:comment>

    (themis_test) CQnew1: usedToMake domain Grape -> Absent; usedToMake range Wine -> Absent
    (other) CQnew1: usedToMake domain Grape -> Absent; usedToMake range Wine -> Absent</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/wine#Grape"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/wine#Wine"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Grape -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Wine -->
